data.name: AlAarif
data.gender_notes: AlAarif is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘al-‘arif’, which means ‘the All-Knowing’ or ‘the Wise’. In Islamic context, AlAarif is often used to refer to Allah, as He is the One who knows all things and is aware of all things. The name AlAarif carries the meaning “The All-Knowing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlAarif usually hope their child will grow to embody the all-knowing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents wisdom and knowledge from Allah.
data.etymology: AlAarif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The All-Knowing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlAarif total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
